shared_elements: incised low-relief signs or emblems on a flat field
framing bands enclosing a central area
justification: Both surfaces carry schematic incised motifs including a prominent circular disc/ring set within a bounded field, and both show repeated small block-like emblems. But A is a three-dimensional anthropomorphic figure (head, shoulders, torso with pendant, arms and belt-like bands) with ornaments arranged on a body, while B is a flat rectangular panel with a large hatched sun-disc encircled by a continuous border of paired glyph-like cartouches — the organizing principles and the relationships between elements are quite different.
